Dedicated GeGI cryostat assembly

View the cryostat preview, cross-section and interactive 3D assembly. The exact GeGI detector runs in gegi_cryostat_v1; it does not fit LBNL. Known front-window dimensions and nominal side/rear geometry are identified separately.

All saved GeGI results and their limits · Run the 34-channel workflow locally

GeGI spatial source comparison and blind mixture

Two saved runs use the same gamma energy, detector, electronics, reconstruction cuts and cone weights. The mixture combines isolated events without using their source positions to reconstruct them. Original IDs are qualified by source run key.

Both input lines are 662 keV. The known search-plane assumption is z = 40 mm; this page does not infer depth, range or a three-dimensional source location.

Separation assessment: inconclusive. This bounded comparison does not establish two resolved sources. Peaks in these scores are not fitted source locations.

Blind mixture on the assumed source plane

10000 total emitted primaries remain the denominator; 5 accepted imaging events, 479 rejected nonzero events and 4 ambiguous accepted events. All plane panels share the same color scale, 0 to 0.000412688466 weighted accepted events/mm².

Red crosses show input-source truth only. Their separation does not demonstrate two reconstructed peaks. The fixed 5° kernel is a display regularizer, not a measured resolution. Each candidate retains its recorded valid-order weight; each accepted event integrates to total weight one across candidates on this finite plane.

Supplemental direction maps · far-field approximation

At these nearby source positions, the detector extent is not negligible. Direction-only maps cannot establish spatial source separation. The vertex-aware plane maps above use the declared plane assumption.

Limits and traceability

  • Two separately simulated isolated-event datasets are combined; simultaneous-source pileup is not modeled.
  • Source run keys preserve provenance but do not select interaction orders or modify cone weights.
  • Raw accepted-event contributions and all initial denominators are summed without equalizing source intensities.
  • Sparse or overlapping scores do not establish two resolved sources, a spatial resolution, source range or source activity.
  • The search plane is an explicit input assumption, not an estimated source depth or range.
  • Finite-plane cone backprojection is a display score, not an activity or source-count likelihood.
  • The 5-degree kernel is a fixed display regularizer, not a measured spatial or angular resolution.
  • No source positions, source labels, truth deposits or source-direction choices enter this projection.
  • Simulation-derived central-pixel timing-to-depth table; no per-pixel laboratory depth calibration.
  • Strip-centre transverse positions; charge sharing, unresolved same-strip sites and ambiguous strip pairs are excluded.
  • Only two resolved interactions and configured-line photopeak events are imaged; failed and rejected events remain in results.
  • Both valid orders are retained with equal weights, without selecting by the known source direction.
  • Directional backprojection only; source distance and activity are not reconstructed.
  • 5-degree smoothing is an explicit imaging kernel, not a measured angular resolution; Doppler broadening and measured electronics noise are not modeled.
